summary: Momentus Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $75M in shares of its Class A common stock under a Sales Agreement with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners as sales agent. The shares are issued via Rule 415(a)(4) under a Form S-3 registration statement effective June 4, 2026. No specific price, premium, or timeline is stated; the filing is a routine shelf takedown under an existing registration. This is not a special situation; it is a standard equity financing instrument. What to watch: Potential dilution; no break fee or deal structure beyond the ATM mechanism.
